form.label: BigFix GatherDB Health & Performance
form.description: Monitors database imports, content updates, and critical infrastructure failures.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:gatherdb" ("ERROR" OR "Exception" OR "File error" OR "Connection failed") | rex field=_raw "-- (?<error_message>.*)" | eval error_message=coalesce(error_message, _raw) | search error_message="*ERROR*" OR error_message="*Exception*" OR error_message="*File error*" OR error_message="*Connection failed*" | stats count by error_message | rename error_message AS "Error Details", count AS "Occurrences" | sort - Occurrences

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:gatherdb" (*HTTPGet* OR *establish*) | eval Error_Type = case(searchmatch("*HTTPGet*"), "HTTP Timeout (Port 52311)", searchmatch("*establish*"), "Gather Mirror Reachability Failure", 1==1, "Other Connection Error") | stats count by Error_Type | sort - count

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:gatherdb" "completed successfully" | rex field=_raw "Import of version (?<site_version>\d+) of site (?<site_name>.*) completed successfully" | search site_name="*" | stats count AS Updates, max(site_version) AS "Latest Version" by site_name | rename site_name AS "Site Name" | sort - Updates

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:gatherdb" "GatherDB version" "starting" | rex field=_raw "^(?<timestamp>[^-]+-\d{4}) -- GatherDB version (?<version>[\d\.]+) starting" | table timestamp, version | rename timestamp AS Timestamp, version AS "GatherDB Version" | sort - Timestamp
